Risk Score Interpretation And Action Matrix

RISK SCOREACTION LEVEL
20-25 (EXTREME) 15-19 (HIGH) 10-14 (MEDIUM) 5-9 (LOW) 1-4 (MINIMAL)STOP: Operation must cease immediately. Director-level approval required to resume. URGENT: Senior management review required within 24 hours. Action plan mandatory. PLANNED: Manager review within 1 week. Implement additional controls. MONITOR: Acceptable with routine monitoring. Review annually. ACCEPTABLE: No action required but continue observation.

Detailed Control Measures By Activity

BAGGAGE HANDLING CONTROLS:

Team lifting for loads >25kg Mechanical lifting aids (conveyors, tilt tables) Job rotation every 2 hours Anti-fatigue matting Pre-shift stretching program Ergonomic assessments annually Training on proper lifting techniques Reporting system for discomfort Hydration stations Rest breaks every 2 hours

AIRCRAFT SERVICING CONTROLS:

Marshalling procedures (IATA AHM 411) Wing walkers mandatory for all movements Clearance procedures before vehicle approach Lockout/Tagout for maintenance High visibility PPE required Barricades around work areas Spotters for blind spots Two-way radio communication Daily equipment inspections Pre-operational checks

REFUELING CONTROLS:

Bonding cables before fueling Spill kits at all fueling points Emergency shutoff switches accessible No smoking within 15m Fire extinguishers nearby (40BC rated) Trained personnel only Grounding checks Overfill protection systems Hot refueling permits required Passenger disembarkation for fueling

CATERING SERVICES CONTROLS:

Safety harnesses for height work Vehicle stabilizers deployed Guard rails on elevated platforms Non-slip surfaces Tool lanyards to prevent dropped objects Load limits observed Weather restrictions (no work above 40mph winds) Daily vehicle inspections Three-point contact when climbing Clear communication with flight deck
